name: Add members to a Chat group conversation
description: Add members to a Chat group conversation Adds one or more members to an existing encrypted Chat group conversation, rotating the conversation key. POST /2/chat/conversations/{id}/members
context:
POST /2/chat/conversations/{id}/members
Adds one or more members to an existing encrypted Chat group conversation, rotating the conversation key.
Required: id (path); body (body)

name: Add Conversation Keys
description: Add Conversation Keys Adds (initializes or rotates) the encryption keys for a Chat conversation. POST /2/chat/conversations/{id}/keys
context:
POST /2/chat/conversations/{id}/keys
Adds (initializes or rotates) the encryption keys for a Chat conversation. Call this before sending messages in a new 1:1 conversation, and again with a newer key version to rotate the conversation key. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID as the conversation id; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. The request body must contain the conversation key version and participant keys (the conversation key encrypted for each participant using their public key).
Required: id (path); body (body)

name: Delete Chat messages
description: Delete Chat messages Deletes one or more messages from a Chat conversation. POST /2/chat/conversations/{id}/messages/delete
context:
POST /2/chat/conversations/{id}/messages/delete
Deletes one or more messages from a Chat conversation. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Delete for all removes a message you sent (or, in groups you administer, any message) for every participant; delete for self removes any message only from your own view.
Required: id (path); body (body)

name: Get Chat Conversation
description: Get Chat Conversation Returns metadata for a Chat conversation including type, muted status, and group details. GET /2/chat/conversations/{id}
context:
GET /2/chat/conversations/{id}
Returns metadata for a Chat conversation including type, muted status, and group details. Use chat_conversation.fields to select which fields are returned. Use expansions to hydrate member, admin, or participant user objects. Use user.fields to control which profile fields are returned for expanded users.
Required: id (path)
Optional: chat_conversation.fields (query) — A comma separated list of ChatConversation fields to display.; expansions (query) — A comma separated list of fields to expand.; user.fields (query) — A comma separated list of User fields to display.

name: Get Chat Conversation Events
description: Get Chat Conversation Events Retrieves messages and key change events for a specific Chat conversation with pagination support. GET /2/chat/conversations/{id}/events
context:
GET /2/chat/conversations/{id}/events
Retrieves messages and key change events for a specific Chat conversation with pagination support. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient.
Required: id (path)
Optional: max_results (query); pagination_token (query); chat_message_event.fields (query) — A comma separated list of ChatMessageEvent fields to display.

context:

Optional: max_results (query); pagination_token (query); chat_conversation.fields (query) — A comma separated list of ChatConversation fields to display.; expansions (query) — A comma separated list of fields to expand.; user.fields (query) — A comma separated list of User fields to display.

name: Initialize Chat Group
description: Initialize Chat Group Initializes a new Chat group conversation and returns a unique conversation ID. POST /2/chat/conversations/group/initialize
context:
POST /2/chat/conversations/group/initialize
Initializes a new Chat group conversation and returns a unique conversation ID. Use the returned conversation_id in a subsequent POST /chat/conversations/group call to fully create and configure the group.

context:

name: Send Chat Message
description: Send Chat Message Sends an encrypted message to a specific Chat conversation. POST /2/chat/conversations/{id}/messages
context:
POST /2/chat/conversations/{id}/messages
Sends an encrypted message to a specific Chat conversation. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. A recipient who cannot be messaged (closed inbox, system/notification account, or a 1:1 block) returns HTTP 403 with type https://api.x.com/2/problems/recipient-not-messageable.
Required: id (path); body (body)
